比如说施工搭建怎么样？

Oh, you'd be great at directing.

I disagree with your internal monologue.

I, I think directors, they have to be able to look at things from the outside.
sentences.zh: 我，我觉得导演，他们必须能够从局外审视事物。

sentences.zh: 而且比如创作，他们必须构想出整幅画面。

sentences.zh: 而且我，我觉得不会，我只是觉得，我的大脑不是那样运作的。

sentences.en: Like I'm all character, you know, and from the inside out.
sentences.zh: 比如我完全注重角色，你知道的，由内而外。

sentences.zh: 所以我觉得我根本不知道该把镜头指向哪里，或者告诉大家

sentences.en: Like, I don't see it that way when I read it, but I would love to be a director because
sentences.zh: 就像，我读的时候并不那样看它，但我很想当一名导演，因为

sentences.en: then I would be on set and I'd be in the creative process, but I will not have ever

sentences.zh: 所以那会是我梦想中的工作选择。

sentences.en: You know, it's been a long time, but I had directed some theater and stuff in college.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那是很久以前的事了，但我在大学时导演过一些戏剧什么的。

sentences.en: And the only thing for me is because I do like a big picture.
sentences.zh: 对我来说唯一的问题是，因为我确实喜欢大局。

sentences.en: It's like, there was this one gal who just was not getting the note for this performance
sentences.zh: 就像，当时有这么个姑娘，就是无法领会这场表演的

sentences.en: And I just needed to just be like, just, she's just going to do it her way.
sentences.zh: 我当时只想说，算了，她就按她自己的方式来吧。

sentences.en: She can't like process any kind of change.
sentences.zh: 她根本无法处理任何形式的改变。

sentences.en: And, but I think I was a little, I think I maybe was a little short.
sentences.zh: 而且，但我觉得自己有点，我当时可能有点没耐心。

sentences.en: Well, this is another thing about directing, which is that you get asked so many questions
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是导演的另一面，那就是你会整天

sentences.en: I don't have the temperament for that.
So in that way, I don't think I...
sentences.zh: 所以从这方面来说，我觉得我……

sentences.en: It's your wedding day every single day.
sentences.zh: 那感觉就像每天都是你的婚礼。

sentences.en: Do you want this color cranberry or that color cranberry?
sentences.zh: 你想要这种蔓越莓色还是那种蔓越莓色？

sentences.en: And then you have someone come up to you who's just like, you're in the middle of something
sentences.zh: 然后就会有人走到你面前，就在你正忙着什么事情的时候

sentences.en: and they're like, there's no toilet paper in the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 对你说，洗手间里没有厕纸了。

sentences.en: I'm not in charge of toilet paper today.
sentences.zh: 我今天可不管厕纸的事。

sentences.en: But just people just come up and say all kinds of stuff.
sentences.zh: 但人们就是会走过来跟你说各种各样的事。

sentences.en: You have to solve every problem.
sentences.zh: 你必须解决每一个问题。

sentences.en: And you have to be nice.

sentences.zh: 所以这位女士，你想做什么呢？

sentences.en: Should I say the things I think you shouldn't do?
sentences.zh: 我该说出那些我认为你不该做的事吗？

sentences.en: And I don't think you should run catering.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得你不应该负责餐饮。

sentences.en: You can be in charge of crafty.
I could be in charge of snacks.
I don't want you to cook the meals.
You probably don't want me to.
I'm good at like one dish at a time.
sentences.zh: 我一次只能做好一道菜之类的。

sentences.en: I am not a short order chef.
But also, you have a very limited number of meals that you cook well.
sentences.zh: 而且，你做得好的菜品数量非常有限。

sentences.en: I'm going to be eating the same thing all the time.
sentences.zh: 那我得一直吃同样的东西了。

sentences.en: I would actually very much enjoy being crafty on set.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我其实非常喜欢在片场负责后勤。

sentences.en: Because then I could figure out what people's favorite snacks are.
sentences.zh: 因为那样我就可以弄清楚大家最喜欢什么零食。

sentences.en: And it's like a love language to take care of you.
sentences.zh: 照顾你们就像是一种爱的语言。

sentences.en: I could make sure you had your favorite jelly beans or.
sentences.zh: 我可以确保你们有最喜欢的果冻豆或者别的什么。

sentences.en: You'd be great at crafty lady.

sentences.zh: 我会很喜欢负责后勤的。

sentences.en: The other one that I thought would be fun would be to be a gaffer.
sentences.zh: 另一个我觉得会很有趣的工作是当灯光师。

sentences.en: I love seeing how light changes a scene.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢看光线如何改变一个场景。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a super cool, like, artistic job.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个超级酷的、类似艺术的工作。

sentences.en: Like, if there's a fakie window, you have to make me believe that's a real window using light.
sentences.zh: 比如说，如果有假窗户，你得用光让我相信那是真窗户。

sentences.en: And you know what else I think is so cool?
sentences.zh: 而且你知道我觉得还有什么特别酷的吗？

sentences.en: And we only did this a handful of times on the set of The Office, but I've done it on movies plenty of times, where you're filming and it's broad daylight,
sentences.zh: 我们在《办公室》片场只这么做过几次，但我在电影里做过好多次，就是你在拍戏的时候明明是大白天，

sentences.en: but they make everything to look like nighttime.
sentences.zh: 但他们把一切都弄得像夜里一样。

sentences.en: They call it day for night.
sentences.zh: 他们把这叫作日戏夜拍。

sentences.en: And they black out the windows.
But then they'll let a little light through, like it's moonlight.
sentences.zh: 但随后他们会透进一点光，就像月光一样。

sentences.en: But you step outside and it's three o'clock in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 然而你走到外面去，发现其实才下午三点。

sentences.en: I don't know if I'd be good at it, but I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道自己擅不擅长，但我真的很欣赏。

sentences.en: So basically, if I wasn't acting, you think I'd be in charge of crafty?
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，如果我不演戏了，你觉得我会去负责剧组餐饮吗？

sentences.en: And I would love to be directing, but I'm not sure it would be my strong suit.
sentences.zh: 而且我很想当导演，但我不确定这算不算我的强项。

sentences.en: So I might be line producing.
sentences.zh: 所以我可能会当制片主任。
我可能会当你的副导演。

sentences.en: I think I'd be good at it.

sentences.zh: 你会是个很棒的副导演。

sentences.en: I think I would like it.

sentences.zh: 而且如果我是第一副导演，我就能去片场，还能参与所有好玩的事情。

sentences.en: And I'd be on set as crafty.
sentences.zh: 而且我作为管餐饮的也会在片场。

sentences.en: I'd be right outside the door there, but on stage.
sentences.zh: 我就在那扇门外面，但在摄影棚里。

sentences.en: Crafty is a lot of times on the stage.
sentences.zh: 剧组餐饮通常都在摄影棚里。

sentences.en: And it's just sort of behind, like, the main structures that you're filming in.
sentences.zh: 它差不多就在你拍摄的主布景后面。

sentences.en: So you kind of have to be quiet over there.
sentences.zh: 所以你在那边得保持安静。

sentences.en: Because, you know, you've got your snacks.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，你得管零食。

sentences.en: But you see all the actors and the crew.
sentences.zh: 但你能看见所有的演员和剧组成员。

sentences.en: Well, if I were second AD, then I would be back there with you.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果我是第二副导演，那我就能和你在后面了。

sentences.en: And then we would be best friends again.
